description: Scales, ledgers, and someone who knows what everything is worth.
greeting: Buying, selling, or just looking at my scales?
early_value: Convert what a world has too much of into what it lacks.
late_value: The only source of reagents and off-world goods you cannot dig up.

description: Stalls, straw, and the smell of a great many animals.
greeting: Bring them in. I've stalls free, and I know my bloodlines.
early_value: Breed before you can afford a pen of your own.
late_value: Board creatures across a jump — boarded stock never starves.

description: Clean linen, hard light, and a row of narrow beds.
early_value: Patch up after a fight you nearly lost.
late_value: Strip a trauma mark out of a bloodline before it entrenches.

description: Racks of tablets, most of them about animals.
greeting: Everything anyone here has learned is on these racks.
early_value: Buy research outright when you have goods but no time.
late_value: Assay a creature to reveal the recessives it is hiding.

description: Long tables, a bad fire, and everyone's business.
greeting: Sit. There's always someone looking for a berth off-world.
early_value: Hire your first extra pair of hands.
late_value: Rumours point at worlds worth the fuel to reach.

description: Benches worn into hollows by other people's hands.
greeting: Bench is free if you've brought your own materials.
early_value: Craft without hauling a workbench across the galaxy.
late_value: Access to stations you have not researched yet.

description: More space than anyone here appears to need.
greeting: Storage by the crate. Hull expansion if you've the ore.
early_value: Stash the overflow you cannot carry yet.
late_value: Permanently expand the hold — the hard cap on everything.

description: Something in here makes the animals go quiet.
greeting: Your creatures already know why they are here. Do you?
early_value: Read what an animal is becoming before it shows.
late_value: Push a stalled archetype the last of the way to crystallizing.

description: Someone's home. Smoke, washing, a door that sticks.
greeting: You're welcome to the fire for a night.
early_value: Rest the colony to full without burning your own supplies.
late_value: Still the cheapest way to reset exhaustion before a long jump.

description: Soft beds, hanging charms, the next generation under one roof.
greeting: Quiet voices. They learn by watching you.
early_value: A safer place to raise offspring you cannot yet protect.
late_value: Culture is taught here before it is lived outside.

description: A ladder, a platform, and someone who never stops scanning the treeline.
greeting: I saw dust on the south ridge. Or was it smoke.
early_value: Early warning when predators or storms approach.
late_value: The clan's memory of which directions mean death.

description: Rows of half-tamed plants this world almost recognized.
greeting: Take what you need — leave seed if you can.
early_value: Steady forage without ranging into the wild.
late_value: The first step from scavenging toward husbandry.
